premise: Deer thinks everyone forgot his birthday and grazes alone all afternoon; at dusk Bird leads him to the clearing, where Firefly lights up the surprise.
inspiration: The forgotten-birthday folk motif, turned: nobody forgot; the quiet was everyone getting ready.
lesson: Sometimes friends' silence is a surprise on its way.

en-US.title: Deer's Surprise Party
en-US.text: It was {deer:enter} Deer's birthday. {deer:pulse} But nobody said a thing. Not {bird:enter} Bird. Not anybody. {deer:face sad} [sad] Maybe everyone forgot, thought Deer. {deer:live hold} He put his head down and nibbled the grass, all by himself, all afternoon. {canvas:sunset 0.7 30s} As the sun went down, Bird {bird:face happy} {bird:hop} fluttered close. [excited] Deer! Come quickly! {deer:live resume} Deer lifted his head, flicked his ears and looked around. Bird led him to the clearing. It was quiet. [whispers] Hello? {canvas:fireflies 0.8 25s} Then… one little light came drifting in. {firefly:enter} Firefly! {firefly:face happy} And another, and another. {firefly:live hold} Firefly glowed brighter and brighter, like a lantern. {deer:face surprised} {all:hop x2} [excited] SURPRISE! {canvas:confetti 0.9 8s} {sfx:party} Everyone jumped out, and petals flew up like confetti. {deer:face happy} You didn't forget! {bird:live} Bird puffed up his chest, tipped his head back and sang his longest, happiest song. {deer:sparkle} [happily] And Firefly {firefly:live resume} blinked her light twice: happy birthday, Deer.

es-ES.title: La fiesta sorpresa de Ciervo
es-ES.text: Era el cumpleaños de {deer:enter} Ciervo. {deer:pulse} Pero nadie decía nada. Ni {bird:enter} Pájaro. Ni nadie. {deer:face sad} [sad] A lo mejor se les ha olvidado, pensó Ciervo. {deer:live hold} Bajó la cabeza y mordisqueó la hierba, solito, toda la tarde. {canvas:sunset 0.7 30s} Cuando el sol se ponía, Pájaro {bird:face happy} {bird:hop} se acercó revoloteando. [excited] ¡Ciervo! ¡Ven deprisa! {deer:live resume} Ciervo levantó la cabeza, movió las orejas y miró alrededor. Pájaro lo llevó hasta el claro. Estaba callado. [whispers] ¿Hola? {canvas:fireflies 0.8 25s} Entonces… llegó flotando una lucecita. {firefly:enter} ¡Luciérnaga! {firefly:face happy} Y otra, y otra. {firefly:live hold} Luciérnaga brilló más y más, como un farolillo. {deer:face surprised} {all:hop x2} [excited] ¡SORPRESA! {canvas:confetti 0.9 8s} {sfx:party} Todos salieron de su escondite, y los pétalos volaron como confeti. {deer:face happy} ¡No se os había olvidado! {bird:live} Pájaro infló el pecho, echó la cabeza atrás y cantó su canción más larga y más alegre. {deer:sparkle} [happily] Y Luciérnaga {firefly:live resume} parpadeó dos veces con su luz: feliz cumpleaños, Ciervo.
